mapper.select: SELECT a.id FROM application a JOIN app_user u ON a.owner_id=u.id AND a.workspace_id=u.workspace_id AND u.login_id=#{login} AND a.created_at < #{cutoff} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id=u.id AND ur.role_code='APPLICANT') ORDER BY a.id LIMIT 100

SELECT a.id FROM application a JOIN app_user u ON a.owner_id=u.id AND a.workspace_id=u.workspace_id AND u.login_id=#{login} AND a.created_at < #{cutoff} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id=u.id AND ur.role_code='APPLICANT') WHERE a.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document_intake WHERE application_id=#{id} AND status IN ('QUEUED','PROCESSING')) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ocr_job j JOIN document d ON d.id=j.document_id WHERE d.application_id=#{id} AND j.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING'))
SELECT result_json FROM document_intake WHERE result_json IS NOT NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE c FROM intake_analysis_cache c JOIN app_user u ON u.id=c.owner_id AND u.workspace_id=c.workspace_id WHERE u.login_id=#{login} AND c.created_at < #{cutoff}
DELETE f FROM field_confirmation f JOIN document d ON d.id=f.document_id WHERE d.application_id=#{id}
DELETE r FROM ocr_result r JOIN ocr_job j ON j.id=r.job_id JOIN document d ON d.id=j.document_id WHERE d.application_id=#{id}
DELETE j FROM ocr_job j JOIN document d ON d.id=j.document_id WHERE d.application_id=#{id}
DELETE rd FROM revision_document rd JOIN application_revision r ON r.id=rd.revision_id WHERE r.application_id=#{id}
DELETE r FROM supplement_response r JOIN supplement_request s ON s.id=r.request_id WHERE s.application_id=#{id}
DELETE i FROM supplement_item i JOIN supplement_request s ON s.id=i.request_id WHERE s.application_id=#{id}
DELETE s FROM intake_source s JOIN document_intake j ON j.id=s.intake_id WHERE j.application_id=#{id}
